name: com.megvii.faceee_sdk.zxinglibrary.android.QrCodeScanActivity
description: During Face++ FaceEE QR sign-in, this Activity uses the camera or a selected image to read a code, checks it with FaceEE, and opens the next verification screen.
disableEffect: FaceEE QR-code sign-in cannot scan the code or continue to verification.
